Read setup guide

This dashboard presents a saved research record, not a live AI service. The English edition preserves the original sources and dates; they have not been re-audited for this translation. Hypotheses are conjectures, and scores are heuristic judgments—not probabilities. Use the source package to run a new study with your own research agent.
